name: Luoyanggia
sum: Oviraptorid from the Aptian–Albian Haoling Formation of the Ruyang Basin, Henan, China.
wsnote: Estimate by Holtz; Molina-Pérez and Larramendi gave a similar size.
holotype: Specimen from the Haoling Formation, Ruyang Basin, Henan, China (Lü et al. 2009).
biology: First thought to be Cenomanian, its formation is now dated to the Aptian–Albian.
author: Lü et al. 2009

sources.text: J. Lü, L. Xu, and X. Jiang, S. Jia, M. Li, C. Yuan, X. Zhang, Q. Ji. 2009. A preliminary report on the new dinosaurian fauna from the Cretaceous of the Ruyang Basin, Henan Province of central China. Journal of the Paleontological Society of Korea 25(1):43-56
